label: Developer Tools
description: Source control, issue tracking, CI/CD, deploys, monitoring and package registries.

nodes.label: GitHub: Create Issue
nodes.description: Open a new issue in a GitHub repository via the REST API.
nodes.search: github issue create open bug ticket report repo

config.label: Owner
config.help: Repository owner (user or org)

config.label: Body
config.help: Issue body (Markdown)

credentials.help: Personal access token or fine-grained token with Issues: write on the repo

nodes.label: GitHub: List Issues
nodes.description: List issues in a GitHub repository, filtered by state.
nodes.search: github issues list open closed repo fetch bugs tickets

config.label: State
config.help: open, closed or all

credentials.help: Token with Issues: read on the repo (or any token for public repos)

nodes.label: GitHub: Get Repository
nodes.description: Fetch metadata for a GitHub repository (stars, forks, default branch, …).
nodes.search: github repo repository metadata stars forks info fetch details

credentials.help: Token with repo read access (public repos work with any valid token)

nodes.label: GitHub: List Pull Requests
nodes.description: List pull requests in a GitHub repository, filtered by state.
nodes.search: github pull requests pr list open merged closed review repo

config.label: State
config.help: open, closed or all

credentials.help: Token with Pull requests: read on the repo

nodes.label: GitHub: Create Issue Comment
nodes.description: Add a comment to a GitHub issue or pull request.
nodes.search: github comment issue pull request reply post discuss

config.label: Comment
config.help: Comment text (Markdown)

credentials.help: Token with Issues: write on the repo

nodes.label: GitHub: Search Code
nodes.description: Search code across GitHub with the code search API.
nodes.search: github search code find grep source repo:qualifier query

config.label: Query
config.help: Code search query; supports qualifiers like repo:, org:, language:, path:

credentials.help: Any valid token — code search requires authentication

nodes.label: GitHub: Search Repositories
nodes.description: Search repositories across GitHub by keywords and qualifiers.
nodes.search: github search repositories repos find discover stars language topic

config.label: Query
config.help: Repo search query; supports qualifiers like language:, stars:>n, topic:

credentials.help: Any valid token (raises the rate limit)

nodes.label: GitHub: Get File Contents
nodes.description: Read a file from a GitHub repository (content returned base64-encoded).
nodes.search: github file contents read fetch raw blob path repo download

config.label: File path
config.help: Path within the repo (no leading slash)

config.label: Ref
config.help: Branch, tag or commit SHA (defaults to the default branch)

credentials.help: Token with Contents: read on the repo

nodes.label: GitHub: List Commits
nodes.description: List recent commits in a GitHub repository.
nodes.search: github commits list history log changes recent sha branch

config.label: Per page
config.help: Number of commits to return (max 100)

credentials.help: Token with Contents: read on the repo

nodes.label: GitHub: Trigger Workflow
nodes.description: Trigger a GitHub Actions workflow run via workflow_dispatch (returns 204 on success).
nodes.search: github actions workflow dispatch trigger run ci pipeline deploy

config.label: Workflow
config.help: Workflow file name (e.g. ci.yml) or numeric workflow ID; must have a workflow_dispatch trigger

config.label: Ref
config.help: Branch or tag to run the workflow on

credentials.help: Token with Actions: write on the repo

nodes.label: GitLab: Create Issue
nodes.description: Open a new issue in a GitLab project via the REST API v4.
nodes.search: gitlab issue create open bug ticket project report

config.label: Project
config.help: Numeric project ID or full path (e.g. group/project)

config.label: Description
config.help: Issue description (Markdown)

credentials.help: Personal access token with api scope (gitlab.com)

nodes.label: GitLab: List Merge Requests
nodes.description: List merge requests in a GitLab project, filtered by state.
nodes.search: gitlab merge requests mr list opened merged closed review project

config.label: Project
config.help: Numeric project ID or full path (e.g. group/project)

config.label: State
config.help: opened, closed, merged, locked or all

credentials.help: Personal access token with read_api scope (gitlab.com)

nodes.label: Jira: Create Issue
nodes.description: Create an issue in Jira Cloud via the REST API v3.
nodes.search: jira issue create ticket task bug story atlassian project

config.label: Site URL
config.help: Your Jira Cloud base URL, no trailing slash

config.label: Issue type
config.help: Issue type name, e.g. Task, Bug, Story

config.label: Description
config.help: Plain-text description (wrapped into Atlassian Document Format)

credentials.help: Atlassian account email
API token from id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens

nodes.label: Jira: Search Issues (JQL)
nodes.description: Search Jira Cloud issues with a JQL query via the enhanced search API.
nodes.search: jira search jql query issues filter find atlassian list

config.label: Site URL
config.help: Your Jira Cloud base URL, no trailing slash

config.label: JQL
config.placeholder: project = ENG AND status = "In Progress" ORDER BY created DESC

credentials.help: Atlassian account email
API token from id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens

nodes.label: Linear: Create Issue
nodes.description: Create an issue in Linear via the GraphQL API.
nodes.search: linear issue create ticket task graphql team tracker

config.label: Team ID
config.help: Linear team UUID (query the teams { nodes { id name } } GraphQL field to find it)

config.label: Description
config.help: Issue description (Markdown)

credentials.help: Personal API key (lin_api_…) from Linear Settings → Security & access; sent as-is in the Authorization header

http.body: {"query": "mutation($input: IssueCreateInput!) { issueCreate(input: $input) { success issue { id identifier url } } }", "variables": {"input": {"teamId": {{json config.teamId}}, "title": {{json config.title}}, "description": {{json config.description}}}}}

nodes.label: Sentry: List Issues
nodes.description: List issues for a Sentry project, optionally filtered by a search query.
nodes.search: sentry issues errors list monitoring exceptions crashes unresolved

config.label: Query
config.help: Sentry search query, e.g. is:unresolved or is:assigned

credentials.help: Auth token with project:read (or org auth token) from sentry.io settings

nodes.label: PagerDuty: Trigger Event
nodes.description: Trigger an alert event via the PagerDuty Events API v2.
nodes.search: pagerduty alert incident trigger page oncall event escalate

config.label: Summary
config.help: Brief description of the event

config.label: Source
config.help: Unique location of the affected system

config.label: Severity
config.help: critical, error, warning or info

credentials.help: Integration/routing key (32 chars) from an Events API v2 integration on a service

nodes.label: CircleCI: Trigger Pipeline
nodes.description: Trigger a pipeline for a project branch via the CircleCI API v2.
nodes.search: circleci pipeline trigger build ci run branch deploy

config.label: Project slug
config.help: vcs/org/repo, e.g. gh/my-org/my-repo or circleci/<org-id>/<project-id>

credentials.help: Personal API token from app.circleci.com/settings/user/tokens

nodes.label: Vercel: List Deployments
nodes.description: List recent deployments for the authenticated Vercel account or team.
nodes.search: vercel deployments list deploy status preview production hosting

config.label: Limit
config.help: Max number of deployments to return

credentials.help: Access token from vercel.com/account/tokens (scope it to the right team)

nodes.label: Netlify: Trigger Build Hook
nodes.description: Trigger a site build via a Netlify build hook URL (the URL itself is the secret).
nodes.search: netlify build hook trigger deploy site rebuild static hosting

config.label: Build hook URL
config.help: From Site settings → Build & deploy → Build hooks

nodes.label: npm: Get Package Info
nodes.description: Fetch the latest published version metadata for an npm package (keyless).
nodes.search: npm package registry version javascript node dependency lookup latest

config.label: Package name
config.help: Package name, scoped names like @scope/name supported

nodes.label: PyPI: Get Package Info
nodes.description: Fetch metadata for a Python package from the PyPI JSON API (keyless).
nodes.search: pypi python package version pip dependency registry lookup latest
